details: Malicious package. An install script runs `node index.js`, which collects host information, resolves the victim's public IP via `api.ipify.org` and sends the data to an attacker-controlled Telegram bot (`api.telegram.org`). Observed in a sandboxed install. `index.js` (sha256 6dadbe82aed922721b282d66ab824b914fa366003888e6994368e5dbd8aee78d) is byte-identical to the one in `carboniteapp` (MAL-2026-19151) and several other dependency-confusion packages. Published 2026-05-06 and removed from npm the same day.
